name: Nippon Hume Corporation
summary: Nippon Hume Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of pipes and concrete piles in Japan. It offers pipeline products, such as hume tubes, composite steel-concrete pipes, JIP pipes, super large diameter propulsion tubes, box culverts, arch culverts, precast utility tunnels, prefabricated manholes and connection holes, wellman systems, antibacterial concrete products, and fiber-optic-compatible concrete products; concrete piles; RC segments; and PC and composite wells, and press casts and PRC hollow piers.
